blocks.text: 1. Clinical trials aur medical research

Clinical trials (insanon par dawa ya ilaaj ke tajarbe) aur medical research mein biostatistics bohat ahem hai. Yeh studies design karne aur data ka analysis karne ka dhaancha (framework) deti hai, taa ke nataij durust aur bharosemand hon. Statistical tareeqon se biostatisticians nayi dawaon, ilaaj aur medical aalaat (devices) ki hifazat (safety) aur asar (effectiveness) jaanchte hain. Is se doctors saboot ki bunyad par (evidence-based) faisle karte hain jo mareezon ki dekh bhaal behtar karte aur medical ilm barhate hain.
2. Epidemiology

Epidemiology (bimariyon ke phailao ka ilm) mein biostatistics se dekha jata hai ke population mein bimariyan kahan aur kitni hain (distribution) aur kin wajah se hoti hain (determinants). Is se public health ke mahireen samajhte hain ke bimari kaise phailti hai, risk factors (khatre ki wajahen) pehchante hain aur bachao ke iqdamaat ka asar jaanchte hain. Bimari ke rujhanaat (trends) ka model bana kar aur iqdamaat ke nataij parakh kar biostatistics wabaon (epidemics) ko rokne aur community ki sehat behtar karne mein madad deti hai.
3. Genetics aur genomics

Genetics aur genomics ka shoba pecheeda genetic data ke analysis ke liye biostatistics par bohat bharosa karta hai. Is mein genes aur bimariyon ka taalluq dhoondna, virasat ke patterns (inheritance patterns) samajhna aur genetic farq (variations) dekhna shamil hai. Personalized medicine mein, jahan ilaaj har shakhs ke genetic profile ke mutabiq banaya jata hai, biostatistical tareeqe zaroori hain, taa ke asar barhe aur nuqsan wale asraat (adverse effects) kam hon.
4. Public health policy

Biostatistics population ki sehat ka data aur sehat ke programmes jaanch kar public health policy banane mein madad deti hai. Yeh kamzor groups aur sehat mein na-barabari (health disparities) pehchanti hai, aur policy banane walon ko saboot deti hai taa ke woh aise iqdamaat karein jo barabari (equity) laayen aur bare paimane par sehat behtar karein.
5. Environmental health

Environmental health (mahol aur sehat) mein biostatistics se jaancha jata hai ke pollution (aaloodgi) aur toxins (zehreele maadde) jaisi mahol ki cheezen insani sehat par kya asar dalti hain. Statistical analysis nuqsan deh exposure pehchanta hai aur aise qawaneen (regulations) aur bachao ke tareeqe banane mein rehnumai karta hai jo logon ko mahol ke khatron se bachayen.
6. Bioinformatics

Bioinformatics mein biostatistics genomics aur proteomics ke bohat bare biological datasets ke analysis mein madad deti hai. Algorithms aur models bana kar biostatisticians pecheeda data ka matlab nikalte hain, jo nayi dawa dhoondne (drug discovery), bimari ki tashkhees (diagnosis) aur personalized ilaaj banane ke liye zaroori hai.
7. Healthcare quality control

Sehat ki khidmaat ka miyaar (quality) check aur behtar karne ke liye bhi biostatistics istemal hoti hai. Statistical tools se hospitals tashkhees ke tests ki durusti jaanchte hain, mareezon ke nataij ka record rakhte hain aur medical procedures ko yaksaan (consistent) rakhte hain; is se mareezon ki dekh bhaal behtar hoti hai.
8. Health programmes aur population interventions

Biostatistics sehat ke programmes aur poori population ke liye kiye gaye iqdamaat (interventions) ka asar naapti hai. Is se public health ke afsar samajhte hain ke teekon ki muhim (immunization campaigns), sehat ki taleem aur health workers ki training ka kya asar hua. Yeh jaanch wasail (resources) ko sahih jagah lagane aur public health ke kaamon ka faida barhane ke liye zaroori hai.
9. Wabaon par qaboo (controlling epidemics)

Waba (epidemic) ke dauran biostatistics bimari ke phailao ka peecha karne, mortality rate (amwaat ki sharah) ka andaza lagane aur khatre wali population pehchanne mein bohat ahem hai. Yeh fauri (real-time) analysis faisle karne mein madad deta hai aur aise khaas iqdamaat karwata hai jo outbreak (bimari ka achanak phailao) ko roken aur us ke asraat kam karein.
10. Ilaaj tak pohanch ki rukawatein (barriers to care)

Biostatistics surveys ke data aur sehat ki khidmaat ke istemal ke patterns ka analysis kar ke woh rukawatein dhoondti hai jo logon ko ilaaj tak pohanchne se rokti hain. Is se hospitals aur policy banane wale aise tareeqe banate hain jo ilaaj tak pohanch aasan karein, na-barabari kam karein, aur sehat ka nizam zyada mo'assar (efficient) aur munsifana (equitable) banayen.
11. Health risk assessment aur demography

Aakhir mein, biostatistics sehat ke khatron ke andaze (health risk assessment) aur demography (aabadi ka ilm) mein ahem hai: yeh paidaish, amwaat, bimari ke aam hone (prevalence) aur doosre vital statistics ke rujhanaat ka analysis karti hai. Is se sarkari idaron aur sehat ki tanzeemon ko khidmaat ki planning, wasail ki taqseem aur public health ke masail hal karne ke liye zaroori maloomat milti hain. Yeh tamam istemal dikhate hain ke duniya bhar mein sehat behtar karne ke liye biostatistics kitni zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Waba (epidemic) ke dauran biostatistics kis tarah madad karti hai? Koi do tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke mutabiq yeh bimari ke phailao ka peecha karti hai, mortality rate (amwaat ki sharah) ka andaza lagati hai aur khatre wali population pehchanti hai; in fauri nataij se outbreak rokne ke khaas iqdamaat kiye jate hain.

items: Gyarah istemal: clinical trials, epidemiology, genetics, public health policy, environmental health, bioinformatics, quality control, health programmes, wabaon par qaboo, ilaaj ki rukawatein, risk assessment aur demography.
Har jagah biostatistics data se saboot deti hai jis par sehat ke faisle hote hain.
